messages:
marta: quick update — NovaSilicon confirmed a small preview (they're calling it a 'hardware scout') next week. NDA signed on their side. we need: benchmark plan, telemetry keys, SI integration checklist, and a short joint-run schedule. link to draft NDA + checklist: https://redwood/docs/partnerships/nova-scout-nondisclosure (internal) :eyes:

ow: can folks volunteer to own the bench run and the SI coordination? thinking 4 runs over 48h with 2 model variants.

ow: @owen, @suresh, @isabel, tagging infra-bot for staging cluster prep.

ow: also — Nova asked if we can package a tiny marketplace listing for a private preview (not public). need requirements from GTM / marketplace team.

ow: thanks!

ow: (posted by infra-bot) staging cluster 'nova-scout-qa' scheduled for provisioning at 2026-04-02T09:00Z. status: pending 

ow: owen: i can run the perf sweep. which model checkpoints are we validating? are we validating redwood-alpha-1 and alpha-q4_8 only, or they'd accept smaller variants? also what's the target p99 latency for 2k tokens?

marta: target p99 <= 450ms for 2k tokens on their hw for the larger variant; smaller variant target is <= 220ms. we'll confirm exact checkpoints in the shared doc.

suresh: i'll own the bench runs. here's the harness i'll use — please review and flag if it doesn't match Nova's expectations:

```bash
python run_bench.py \  --model redwood-alpha-1 \  --seq 2048 \  --batch 4 \  --threads 8 \  --profile perf.json \  --warmup 128\n```

suresh: upload results to s3://redwood-partners/nova-scout/ and attach perf.json plus raw logs. i'll also capture KV cache hit metrics and time-to-first-token.

isabel: noted — NDA scope looks fine but we need export-control classification (ECCN). nova must provide ECCN and attestations before we run anything. also require KMS key rotation policy for telemetry buckets; don't send raw customer prompts to Nova.

marta: good catch @isabel. i've asked Nova for ECCN and a short attestation. we'll redact any customer data before sharing.

kevin: from SI side, EdgeOps wants a short integration checklist (auth, network ACLs, deployment artefacts). can we have a minimal doc for them to validate? propose a 30-min sync with EdgeOps, Nova, and us on Tue/Thu next week. i'm available Tue 10-11 PT.

ow: owen: for quantization — if Nova's runtime prefers int8 paths we should produce a quantized variant and run accuracy + regression evals. can we add a small eval set (50 prompts) and track rouge/em/perf deltas?

marta: yes — add an eval step to the plan. @suresh please include eval run after perf sweep.

suresh: will do. plan timeline: provision cluster (infra-bot), bench sweep (day 1), quant eval + regression checks (day 2), collate report and short findings doc (end of day 3).

infra-bot: cluster 'nova-scout-qa' now UP — nodes: 4x A100-equivalent (partner lab). ephemeral creds available at /vault/partners/nova-scout/creds — rotate after use.

isabel: confirm we have a retention policy for telemetry (30 days raw, 180 days aggregates). also please encrypt at rest with customer KMS.

marta: noted. i've added retention and KMS items to the checklist.

kevin: i'll loop in EdgeOps + marketplace PM to get the private listing requirements. can someone draft a one-pager for marketplace packaging (what artifacts, licensing blurb, and access flow)?

marta: i'll draft the one-pager and post to the doc by EOD today. owners summary: bench runs — suresh, eval + quant — owen, security/compliance — isabel, SI + marketplace liaison — kevin. i'll schedule the joint sync for Tue 10 PT and send invites. :white_check_mark:

marta: tiny ask — if you run any initial tests before the joint call, drop a short note in this thread with s3 path so we can review ahead of the meeting.

ow: kevin: got it, will add EdgeOps to the invite.

now: suresh: starting bench prep now, will post a smoke-run log by EOD.

marta: great — thanks team. ping me if Nova sends ECCN or additional constraints.

marta: follow-up in 24h if no perf artifacts in thread.
